title: Array statistics
description:
Write methods that work on an array of numbers.

```
Numbers: [4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42]
Sum: 108
Average: 18.00
Largest: 42 at index 5
Reversed: [42, 23, 16, 15, 8, 4]
```
hints: `for (int n : a)` visits every number; `indexOfMax` needs the index, so use `for (int i = 0; ...)` there.
`reversed` makes `new int[a.length]` and fills `r[i] = a[a.length - 1 - i]`.
requirements: `static int sum(int[] a)`, `static double average(int[] a)`, `static int indexOfMax(int[] a)`, `static int[] reversed(int[] a)`.
`reversed` returns a new array and leaves the original alone.
stretch: Write `static int[] sortedCopy(int[] a)` with `Arrays.copyOf` and `Arrays.sort`, and a median method.
